name: MonarchDownloadReportButton
title: DownloadReportButton
wrapsNative: MonarchButton for one format or Menu with .buttonStyle(.monarch(_:size:)) for several; fileExporter(isPresented:document:contentType:defaultFilename:onCompletion:) with a FileDocument for the file URL to save a prepared file; ProgressView with .monarchLinear; MonarchInlineErrorRetry
summary: Downloads a report in one or several formats, with progress while the file is prepared, a note when it is prepared in the background, the system save dialog for a ready file, and Try again on failure.
whenToUse: Next to a report, table or chart whose data people take away as CSV, Excel or PDF.
whenNotToUse: To share a file or link that already exists, use ShareLink with .buttonStyle(.monarch()). Do not keep people waiting on a long export: return .queued and tell them by notification when the file is ready.
api: init(formats: [MonarchDownloadReportFormat] = [.csv], progress: Double? = nil, variant: MonarchButtonVariant = .secondary, size: MonarchButtonSize = .sm, labels: MonarchDownloadReportButtonLabels = MonarchDownloadReportButtonLabels(), errorMessage: (@MainActor (any Error, MonarchDownloadReportFormat) -> String)? = nil, onDownload: @escaping @MainActor (MonarchDownloadReportFormat) async throws -> MonarchDownloadReportResult)
struct MonarchDownloadReportFormat: Identifiable, Hashable { init(_ label: String, id: String, description: String? = nil); static var csv: MonarchDownloadReportFormat }
enum MonarchDownloadReportResult { case downloaded, queued(message: String?), file(URL) }

options.name: formats
options.description: The formats offered. One shows a plain button titled "Download CSV"; several open a menu titled "Download" with each format's label and description.

options.name: progress
options.description: How far the download is, 0 to 1, while it runs. Drawn as a linear progress bar under the button; without it only the button's spinner shows.

options.name: errorMessage
options.description: Turns a thrown error into the text shown. Default: "The CSV download failed."

options.name: onDownload
options.description: Prepares the file. Return .file(url) to open the system save dialog, .downloaded when the app saved or shared it, .queued(message:) when it is prepared in the background; throw on failure.

states.name: idle
states.description: A button with a download symbol; with several formats, a chevron and a menu.

states.name: preparing
states.description: The button shows a spinner, reads "Preparing CSV…" as its value and does not start a second download; the progress bar shows when progress is given.

states.name: saving
states.description: The system save dialog is open for the prepared file.

states.name: saved
states.description: Back to idle; "CSV downloaded" is announced.

states.name: queued
states.description: A muted note under the button says the file is prepared in the background; it is announced.

states.name: failed
states.description: An inline error with Try again, which repeats the same format; the message is announced.

states.name: disabled
states.description: disabled(true) uses the button's disabled colours.

appearance: The Monarch button of the chosen variant and size, a linear Monarch progress bar under it, the queued note in the caption role and muted text colour, and the inline error row in the danger tone, in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: On the web onDownload saves the file through the browser. On iOS a file needs a place to go, so returning .file(url) opens the system save dialog (fileExporter), and an app that shares instead (ShareLink, a share sheet) returns .downloaded. A cancelled save dialog returns to idle without a message. The web passes the format id to onDownload; iOS passes the whole format. Android ships MonarchDownloadReportButton.
accessibility: The button is a standard Button or Menu with a 44-point touch target; the icons are decorative.
While the file is prepared the button's value is "Preparing CSV…".
Preparing, saved, queued and failed are announced with AccessibilityNotification.Announcement.
The progress bar is named "Download progress" and reads its percentage (system behaviour).
A failure is an inline error with text, an icon and a Try again button, not colour alone.
edgeCases: A progress value outside 0 to 1 is clamped; a value that is not finite is not drawn.
Only one download runs at a time; activating the button again while it is busy does nothing.
The saved file's content type comes from its extension (csv, pdf, xlsx), or plain data.
The menu is disabled while a download runs.
The save dialog, its cancellation and the announcements were compiled and unit-tested as state logic but not run on a device.

examples.title: Several formats with progress
A menu of formats, one prepared in the background
examples.code:
MonarchDownloadReportButton(
    formats: [
        MonarchDownloadReportFormat("CSV", id: "csv", description: "Opens in any spreadsheet"),
        MonarchDownloadReportFormat("PDF", id: "pdf"),
        MonarchDownloadReportFormat("Excel", id: "xlsx"),
    ],
    progress: progress,
    variant: .primary
) { format in
    format.id == "xlsx" ? .queued(message: "We will email the file when it is ready.") : .downloaded
}

parityExceptions.reason: The web shows the Download trigger with its arrow and chevron and the format list under it; on iPhone the formats are the system Menu opened from the trigger, and the open menu covers the trigger in the image. The formats, their descriptions and their order match the web.
parityExceptions.convention: HIG: a list of choices from a button is the system Menu
